scientific_integrity: A complete all-parameter proof combines the fixed-point simplex with finite free relative group-ring chains, a two-periodic resolution, and the orbit-space fundamental group theorem; a standalone checker gives bounded finite cross-checks and a base-case collapse, not an infinite computation.
scientific_limitations: Only the geometric row-exchange quotient of finite linear hexagonal chains; no claim for end reversal, other actions, Borel quotients, or wider grids. Uses the established nonequivariant wedge theorem.
title: Row-exchange quotients of linear hexagonal-chain independence complexes are spheres
